landing.text:
HEADLINE
Stay healthy on the road

SUBHEADLINE
For frequent business travelers, adapts to available space with AI-powered exercises.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps frequent business travelers stay healthy on the road by adapting to limited space and equipment.

WHO IT IS FOR
Frequent business travelers

THE PROBLEM
Limited space and equipment make it hard for frequent business travelers to fit in workouts.

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
YouTube fitness videos were not designed for frequent business travelers, forcing manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Adapts to available space with AI-powered exercises, no need for extra equipment or space.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Start your hotel room workout today.

ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Hotel room workout app helps frequent business travelers stay healthy on the road.

ONBOARDING
1. Create your profile to get started.
2. Set up your account to track progress.
3. Input your goals and preferences to customize workouts.

EMPTY STATE
1. No exercises found. Add a new routine to start working out.
2. Your workout schedule is empty. Start planning today!
3. You haven't set any goals yet. Define what you want to achieve.

ERROR
1. Exercise not found: Try searching again or add a new one.
2. Workout schedule conflict: Reschedule or delete the conflicting session.
3. Goal not met: Adjust your routine or increase intensity to reach target.

TOAST
1. Profile created!
2. Account set up and ready to track progress.
3. Goals defined! Start working towards them today.
4. Exercise added! Get started with your new routine.
5. Workout scheduled! Don't forget to do it.
6. Result saved! Track your progress over time.
7. Settings updated! Your preferences are now reflected in workouts.
8. Account linked! Access all features and track progress.

BUTTON LABELS
1. Create Profile
2. Set Up Account
3. Add Exercise
4. Schedule Workout
5. Define Goals
6. Save Result
7. Update Settings
8. Link Account
